heading: iPhone 15 available under Rs 59,999, no conditions
paragraphs: Apple may have made the iPhone 16 and iPhone 17 more expensive, but the iPhone 15 is still available without a price hike.
You can buy the iPhone 15 on Flipkart right now for Rs 59,900.
This is a flat Rs 20,000 discount on the iPhone 15’s Rs 79,900 launch price.
With bank offers, you can bring the iPhone 15’s effective price down to Rs 56,905.
Mind you, the iPhone 15 is the most affordable new iPhone you can buy. The iPhone 16, for instance, is now priced at Rs 89,900.
Under Rs 60,000, the iPhone 15 could be a pick for those looking for a hassle-free premium experience.
Under the hood, the iPhone 15 uses the A16 Bionic chipset. In our review, the device would easily handle day-to-day tasks, and you can also have some gaming sessions.
The iPhone 15 gets a dual rear camera setup – a 48-megapixel primary and a 12-megapixel ultrawide. Both cameras can give you decent results with good consistency.
On the front, the iPhone 15 packs a 6.1-inch OLED display with the Dynamic Island. The colours are good, and the panel gets quite bright. But it is a 60Hz display.
During our review, the iPhone 15 lasted for a day and some more on a single charge. To top it up, you get USB-C support as well as MagSafe.
